note: The session's shared web-search allowance was already used up when this part started, so research went by fetching known official pages only. Many county, city and school-district sites did not resolve or refused the kit's fetcher (Glasgow 403, louisvilleky.gov 403 after one answer, Laurel, Shelby, Pulaski and Paris did not resolve, Mason County Schools' certificate did not match its name), so most of the 30 candidates are left blank. Covington's Mayor and Commission page does not list Cari McMurtry Garriga; Jessamine County's pages do not list Jared Madison Cobb; Ashland Independent's board page names no members in its text. Louisville Metro Council: Wikipedia's members table lists Jennifer Chappell (District 15) as Democratic, and Metro Council races are partisan in Louisville, while our record files every Metro Council race as 'Nonpartisan office'; no official page confirming the ballot label could be read (louisvilleky.gov answered 403), so this is not filed as a review item, only noted here for a person to check. Anne Gay Donworth is a sitting legislator with a record page: only her campaign website is recorded.
